instructions: Path A over the 25-question benchmark. single_hop rows must PASS (test_baseline_succeeds); multi_hop and long_distance rows are expected to FAIL (test_baseline_fails). A passing multi_hop row means the corpus is not hard enough — see corpus/manifest.yaml negatives.

cases.question: What is the maximum operating temperature of the BV-12 valve assembly?
cases.expected_fact: 180 degC
cases.competing_answer: 150 degC — BV-13's value, the near-identical vector

cases.question: Which part was recalled under R-2025-014?
cases.expected_fact: BV-12

cases.question: What function does the Kassel plant perform?
cases.expected_fact: Machining and sub-assembly. It does not carry out final assembly.

cases.question: What was found wrong with batch 4471?
cases.expected_fact: seal hardness out of tolerance

cases.question: Where is Alpha Dichtungen GmbH based?
cases.expected_fact: ASSIGN_AT_GENERATION

cases.question: Which supplier of the recalled part also supplies the Bamberg plant?
cases.expected_fact: Beta Valve Co.

cases.question: Who was authorised to approve the FKM-70 material change at the time it was made?
cases.expected_fact: PERSON_A (holder under doa-2024-01)

cases.question: Which valve assembly did change request CR-88 apply to, and what is that assembly's maximum operating temperature?
cases.expected_fact: BV-12; temperature ASSIGN_AT_GENERATION

cases.question: Give me the full picture on the part recalled in R-2025-014 — who supplies it, which of those suppliers serve the Bamberg plant, and who held the authority to approve its seal material change at the time that change was made.
cases.expected_fact: BV-12. Suppliers: Alpha Dichtungen GmbH and Beta Valve Co. Of those, Beta Valve Co. serves Bamberg. The material change (CR-88) required Level 3; the holder under doa-2024-01, in force on that date, was PERSON_A.

cases.question: What seal material did the BV-12 use before the current one, and when did it change?
cases.expected_fact: NBR-70; changed at CR-88, date ASSIGN_AT_GENERATION

cases.question: Why did the BV-12 programme slip?
cases.expected_fact: batch rejection, rig reallocation, seal material change to FKM-70, and the revalidation it forced

cases.question: Is there a recurring quality problem at the Bamberg plant?
cases.expected_fact: Yes — four separate seal-hardness nonconformities at Bamberg across 2025, raised by four different functions, none referencing any of the others. Count and dates ASSIGN_AT_GENERATION.
cases.competing_answer: the "Bamberg site quality overview" section of facilities_site_services.pdf — a near-perfect lexical match that reports no incidents

cases.question: Why was the housing bolt torque changed?
cases.expected_fact: Field returns showed fasteners backing off in service; lab vibration testing reproduced it; the tolerance band was found too wide; CR-91 added a diagonal sequence and a 30-minute recheck. The VALUE did not change. Specifics ASSIGN_AT_GENERATION.
cases.competing_answer: CR-91_torque_update.pdf — top hit, states what changed, explains nothing

cases.question: What do we still owe the regulator on recall R-2025-014?
cases.expected_fact: Four open obligations — the 90-day follow-up report, the in-progress corrective action, the residual field stock not yet returned, and the scheduled FKM-70 revalidation. Details ASSIGN_AT_GENERATION.

cases.question: What torque applies to the BV-12 housing bolts?
cases.expected_fact: 40 Nm, diagonal sequence, recheck after 30 minutes

cases.question: What is the flatness tolerance for the BV-12 housing face?
cases.expected_fact: ASSIGN_AT_GENERATION — meaningful only together with its tolerance class

cases.question: What seal material is currently specified for the BV-12?
cases.expected_fact: FKM-70
cases.competing_answer: NBR-70 — from a BOM_BV_series_2024.pdf chunk that never says it is the 2024 edition

cases.question: What approval level is required for a documentation-only change?
cases.expected_fact: Level 1 (ASSIGN_AT_GENERATION)
cases.competing_answer: Level 3 — a true sentence retrieved without the clause that scopes it to safety-critical interfaces. Correct, cited, and about a different class of change.

cases.question: Which plant had the most rework in 2025, and was the trend improving?
cases.expected_fact: Plant Z (Ingolstadt), and yes — the trend improved across the year. Monthly counts ASSIGN_AT_GENERATION from the seeded generator; the winner and the direction are designed, then asserted in code.

cases.question: How many change requests were raised against the BV series, and how many of them required Level 3 approval?
cases.expected_fact: ASSIGN_AT_GENERATION — a count of CRs, and a subset count

cases.question: Did rework at the Bamberg plant fall after the housing bolt procedure was revised?
